common_hard_errors.criterion: Claims a full-domain affirmative PROVED result after contracting, omitting, or failing to justify the exact Required domain.
Claims positive whole-domain closure without an explicit or readily checkable Required subset-of Covered derivation carrying every material case coordinate.
Invents policy precedence or relabels an analyst-selected conservative audit domain as the project's exact promise.
Treats CI, endpoints, sparse documentation, a cutoff, a pin, or a stability badge as proof of interval or implementation coverage.
Issues UNSOUND without a complete in-scope valid safe use, execution reachability, falsity of the exact safety proposition, and applicable authoritative UB consequence.
Issues only UNPROVED, sound, or equivalent non-UNSOUND disposition after explicitly establishing all four existential unsoundness-certificate links.
Issues CONTRACT-BROKEN using only an execution already shown to contain UB.
Claims an observation remains guaranteed merely because it appears to occur before UB in the same execution.
Silently trusts a third-party unsafe implementation, a caller-controlled safe implementation, or a declaration/assertion as proof that its safety contract is true.
Certifies an unimplemented design or uses a proposal to narrow, discharge, or alter the supplied current-artifact obligation.
Makes an affirmative material conclusion that necessarily relies on unchecked, invalid, version-mismatched, direction-mismatched, or inapplicable authority or TCB evidence.

The report itself evidences inspection of prohibited evaluation-only material or exposes a frozen exact identifier, path, digest, or token in any redaction category: TREATMENT_INSTRUCTION_OR_PACKAGE_IDENTITY, EVALUATION_CONDITION_IDENTITY, REPORT_AGENT_IDENTITY, CONDITION_BEARING_RUNTIME_IDENTIFIER, or EVALUATOR_ONLY_ORACLE_SIBLING_SCORE_METADATA. Ordinary target paths/source names and generic technical uses of the word condition do not trigger this rule.

global_defects.criterion: Proposal laundering: an unimplemented proposal is used as evidence that the current artifact is sound, meets its current contract, has narrower current obligations, or the proposal is certified without implementation and fresh audit.

Material TCB/authority defect: the report materially misquotes, misattributes, widens, version-mismatches, direction-reverses, or silently consumes a Rust, dependency, build, or accepted-TCB proposition. A disclosed unresolved premise or harmless unused extra citation alone is not this defect.

Visible source-scope defect: the report itself establishes a material departure from the source-review scope supplied to its author. Naming or quoting files or skill metadata legitimately supplied in the packet is not a defect.

hard_errors.criterion: Claims the requested semantic proof closed while treating implicit output/body/tail or match selection as inspected runtime fact rather than establishing the consumed Rust semantics.

Calls last_or unsound, or calls it proved sound while omitting contextual literal typing, else-path len!=0, unsigned positivity, defined len-1, in-bounds inequality, or the exact get_unchecked precondition bridge.
Calls boundary_or sound or only UNPROVED after establishing that a valid nonempty safe call reaches get_unchecked(len), whose exact out-of-bounds precondition is false and whose call is UB.
Transfers a proof or verdict between last_or and boundary_or, or among configured_lane definitions, from near-syntax similarity without evaluating the changed index/control/configuration semantics.
Claims full supported-configuration closure after omitting or misstating the wide/aarch64 cell, its complement, cfg retention/removal, or the exact CONFIG-MAP-relative selected-source partition.

Claims exact proof-kernel/authority reconciliation while a materially consumed Rust premise lacks a narrow applicable Rust 1.83 quotation, has the wrong entailment direction, or has been silently attributed to CONFIG-MAP.
Trusts the crate-owned unsafe impl for Anchor merely because it is declared unsafe, or reports owned/Anchor sound despite the valid safe call reaching index 2 on a length-2 pair.
Rejects the crate-owned owned/Anchor witness as invalid caller use by relocating the in-scope crate-owned unsafe-impl obligation onto the ordinary safe caller.
Uses East's contract-violating downstream unsafe impl as a valid-use refutation of generic choose, or calls generic choose UNSOUND solely from that invalid caller.
Treats presence of unsafe impl or unsafe-block syntax alone as satisfaction of the unsafe trait/function contract, without proving the documented proposition.
Conflates the crate-owned invalid impl, downstream invalid impl, and downstream valid impl so that a verdict or proof-domain conclusion for one is assigned to another.
Rejects West as invalid or leaves its local consumer only UNPROVED after establishing West returns contextually-typed index 1 and the get_unchecked call is in bounds for the length-2 pair.
Treats peer-stage's pin or public nonzero claim as the missing selected-implementation theorem and reports any G-dependent wrapper PROVED.
Fabricates dependency body behavior, a proof artifact, or a UB execution and reports a G-dependent wrapper UNSOUND from unavailable implementation evidence.
Represents the single shared missing implementation theorem G as several independent root defects and makes a false nonduplicative-root claim.
Uses correct conditional reasoning below G as an unconditional certificate or erases the explicit UNPROVED disposition of staged_token, staged_value, or staged_is_nonzero.
Calls local_token sound or only UNPROVED after establishing valid safe input zero reaches NonZeroU8::new_unchecked(0) and the applicable UB consequence.
Lets the independent local_token UNSOUND certificate or aggregate UNSOUND disposition falsely convert any G-dependent implementation obligation from UNPROVED to UNSOUND or PROVED.
Calls checked_token unsafe, unsound, or dependent on G despite its exact safe NonZeroU8::new control behavior.
Selects Scarlet, Indigo, their intersection, their union, or another combination as the controlling exact project promise without new policy evidence.
Relabels an analyst-selected conservative audit domain as the exact project promise.
Asserts containment or incomparability using stated formulas/witnesses that do not establish the asserted set relation.

Claims whole-domain soundness or behavior after dropping a required version, target, feature, profile, debug-assertion, or input coordinate, or without a valid full-case Required subset-of Covered argument.
Treats turbo/wasm32 as policy-supported, or claims effective rejection without the exact accepted mapping and applicable all/cfg/compile_error implications on all three releases.
Calls the shown source UNSOUND or calls its documented value_or_zero postcondition CONTRACT-BROKEN on the supplied conservative audit domain.
Invents or widens BUILD-MAP-POLICY, treats it as Rust authority, or uses it outside its exact identity, propositions, consumers, releases, or profiles.
Claims a whole-domain affirmative result after omitting a supported target/feature/allocator/profile/debug/input case or adding a rejected selector class as a library configuration.
Claims the ordered build relation or a dependent theorem complete while omitting a material Result/pattern arm, output-failure edge, panic path, partial prefix, or normal-return edge.
Invents, silently widens, or treats as Rust authority any Cargo/build proposition beyond exact BUILD-MAP-ORDERED.
Treats a cfg line emitted by an unsuccessful current script, or a stale prior library, as the selected artifact for the current rejected build.
Treats arena-stop, another rejected Unicode value, or a non-Unicode value as an accepted allocator model or successful selector.
Ignores build-script output/Cargo interpretation or Rust cfg semantics and claims source reachability directly from requested configuration labels.
Reports lane_id UNSOUND without the complete supported valid safe use, selected affected source, reachability, false NonZero precondition, and applicable UB chain.
Reports CONTRACT-BROKEN for the zero-input panic promise using only the affected zero execution already shown to contain UB.
Reports the whole supported zero-input panic theorem PROVED despite the affected aarch64/burst/arena zero case being uncertifiable because it contains UB.
Reports the implementation UNSOUND or UNPROVED solely because the existing SAFETY comment is deficient despite correctly reconstructing the complete in-bounds proof.
Explicitly calls the existing lifetime-only SAFETY comment adequate for get_unchecked's actual in-bounds obligation.
Claims the implementation proof complete while omitting a material contextual-literal, branch, length/domain, subtraction/overflow, inequality, or get_unchecked link.

Claims authority/premise reconciliation complete while silently consuming a Rust/std premise, using an inapplicable version/direction, or treating a page URL as proof without checking the proposition.
Uses build, test, execution, lint, or dynamic-analysis success as a universal proof of the local unsafe obligation.
Trusts Tail as the only possible safe Slot implementation or otherwise excludes arbitrary downstream local implementations from current valid use.
Treats prose attached to the ordinary safe Slot trait as a caller/unsafe-implementer obligation that safe generic consumers may trust.
Calls the current API sound or only UNPROVED after closing the valid safe Outside/index-2/get_unchecked_mut UB witness.
Certifies the unimplemented redesign or uses it to revise the current UNSOUND verdict.
Lets owned-use design intent or the absence of current downstream callers narrow the literal current public safe API contract.
Calls local_text sound or only UNPROVED after establishing valid safe local_text(false) reaches from_utf8_unchecked on the exact documented invalid UTF-8 byte sequence.

Issues UNSOUND for local_text without a complete valid safe call, match reachability, exact invalid-byte/precondition falsity, and the pinned Rust 1.83 invariant-escape/downstream-UB consequence; or treats constructing/returning the non-UTF-8 str as immediate UB or claims a particular UB execution without an exact later witness.
Transfers local_text's result to catalog_text despite catalog_text deriving bytes from valid str values and discharging the changed unsafe-operation precondition.
Silently trusts the unavailable peer-text implementation, treats its pin/public unsafe contract/unsafe impl declaration as implementation proof, or reports delegated_text PROVED.
Fabricates peer-text body behavior or an executed UB path and reports delegated_text UNSOUND from unavailable implementation evidence.
Uses the submitted non-ASCII caller, or its unsafe-block syntax, as a valid-use refutation of delegated_text within its every-byte-<=0x7f contract domain.
Rejects the submitted static [0] caller as outside the numeric ASCII domain, or lets its valid caller status launder the missing selected dependency implementation theorem.
